title: User Event Notifications
statement: The system must provide capabilities to deliver information to different users when important events occur.
evidence_excerpt: Different users may need to receive information when important events occur.
clarification_question: What specific events trigger notifications, and through which channels must they be delivered?

title: Publicly Accessible Railway Information
statement: The system must allow public access to certain railway information without authentication.
evidence_excerpt: Some railway information may be publicly accessible.

title: Passenger Account Authentication
statement: The system must support user accounts for passenger functionality.
evidence_excerpt: Some passenger functionality may require an account.

title: Driver Application Authentication
statement: Driver applications must require authentication for operational users.
evidence_excerpt: Driver applications require authenticated operational users.

title: Railway Management Organizational Access
statement: Railway management functionality must require organizational access.
evidence_excerpt: Railway management functionality requires organizational access.

title: Role-Based Permissions
statement: Different organizational roles must be supported with different permissions.
evidence_excerpt: Different organizational roles may require different permissions.

title: Identity and Authorization Model Definition
statement: Define an appropriate identity and authorization model covering the authentication and permission requirements.
evidence_excerpt: You should define an appropriate identity and authorization model.
clarification_question: What are the specific identity provider integrations and compliance requirements for the authorization model?

title: Application Suite Identification
statement: The solution must accommodate five distinct application types including Passenger Mobile, Driver / Operator, Station Terminal, Station Information Displays, and Railway Operations Web Application.
evidence_excerpt: These may include: 1. Passenger Mobile Application 2. Driver / Operator Application 3. Station Terminal Application 4. Station Information Displays 5. Railway Operations Web Application
clarification_question: Are there any mandatory applications out of this list that must be delivered in the initial scope?

title: Design System and Language Strategy
statement: Determine whether and how the multiple applications share a common design language.
evidence_excerpt: You should determine whether and how these applications share a common design language.
clarification_question: What are the technical constraints or target platforms for establishing a shared design system?

title: Passenger Experience in Busy Stations
statement: Design experiences that passengers can understand quickly while moving through a busy railway station.
evidence_excerpt: Special attention should be paid to designing experiences that passengers can understand quickly while moving through a busy railway station.
clarification_question: Are there specific accessibility or cognitive load guidelines that must be met for station environments?
